guide.villager-news-addon-port.dialogue: Villagers react to actions, mobs, trading, danger, their surroundings, and each other.
guide.villager-news-addon-port.cosmetics: Shear an adult villager for its nose. Interact with a villager to return a nose or give a Mayor Hat, Helmet, Microphone, or Moustache. Shears remove the current cosmetic first.
guide.villager-news-addon-port.specials: Name villagers Mayor Villager, Testificate Man, Villager #5, Villager #9, or Villager Unreachable. Name a sheep Wooly The Sheep.
